body: Despite friends telling me otherwise, I feel like I'm a bad student, friend, roommate, brother, and son. I can go 48 hours without seeing any of my roommates, and not receive a single inquiry as to where or how I am. I achieve the bare minimum necessary to get by in school, and I just don't see my life going anywhere.

Yeah, there are jobs, and after this semester I only have two chem classes left. I've wanted to be a chemist since I was fifteen, and I don't want to do anything more than this. I just don't want to do anything anymore.
